questions.statement: What is the number 10 in words?
questions.context: Learning about numbers up to 100 in English class.

options.feedback: Ten is the English word for the numeral 10.
'Two' is the word for 2, not for 10.
'Twelve' is the word for 12, one more than ten.
'Twenty' is the word for 20, which is 10 more than ten.

questions.statement: Which number comes between forty-one and forty-three?
questions.context: Learning about numbers up to 100 in English class.

options.feedback: 'Fifty' is ten more than forty-three, so it comes after, not between.
Forty-two sits exactly between forty-one and forty-three.
'Forty' comes before forty-one, so it cannot be in the middle.
'Forty-four' is greater than forty-three, so it comes after the pair.

'Ten' is far below the series; each term is ten more than the last.
